name: dsh-tiered-compaction
description: DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：无损折叠 → 落盘 → 软压力 → 有损摘要四层管线，前三层零 LLM 成本。装完即生效。
author: xiaoyaoke1

scripts.check:install: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('tools/check-install.mjs')){console.log('check:install is repo-only: run it from a git checkout (tools/ is not shipped in the npm package)');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['tools/check-install.mjs',...process.argv.slice(1)],{stdio:'inherit'})" --
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');console.log(fs.existsSync('src/single-writer-guard.js')?'dsh-tiered-compaction: single-writer guard present':'WARN: src/single-writer-guard.js missing - double-mount protection incomplete')"
